newsitem.title: USA: GEORGIA-PACIFIC TO EXPAND TISSUE CAPACITY.
newsitem.headline: GEORGIA-PACIFIC TO EXPAND TISSUE CAPACITY.

text.p: Georgia-Pacific Corp said Tuesday it plans to spend 150 million to expand its consumer-tissue business.
The money will be used to build a new tissue machine and associated converting equipment at its Crossett, Ark., operations, it said.

The new tissue machine is expected to be completed by late 1998 and will be capable of producing more than 60,000 tons of premium tissue a year, the company said. The machine would increase the company's capacity by about 10 percent.
